newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Gambro gets S.Korea dialysis rights, supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Gambro gets S.Korea dialysis rights, supply deal.

text.p: Gambro, the medical technology unit of Swedish investment group Incentive, said on Tuesday it agreed with Korea Green Cross Corp to acquire market rights for dialysis products in South Korea as well as supply agreements.

Gambro said its South Korean unit, Gambro Korea Ltd, was also acquiring Korea Green Cross's fixed assets in the form of leased dialysis machines and the accompanying delivery contracts for disposable dialysis products.

"Under the terms of the agreement, Gambro Korea Ltd also becomes the exclusive distributor of hemodialysis concentrate and peritoneal dialysis solutions produced by Korea Green Cross Corp," the company said in a statement.
Gambro said the deal, which comes into effect on July 1, would double Gambro Korea's turnover.
Gambro Korea sales reached about $10 million last year.
This would make the company the leading player in the South Korea dialyser and concentrate markets.
The statement described Korea Green Cross as the largest pharmaceutical producer in South Korea.
